policies.text: Selection of a summit transit contractor requires a vendor with conference delegation handling approval that holds a commercial liability policy of at least $4,000,000.
Priority shuttle clearance is issued to a vendor maintaining Tier-One Transportation Status.

Transportation status at Tier-One level is awarded to any transit vendor that operates an active vehicle fleet of at least 40 motorcoaches, maintains ISO 39001 safety certification, or records a passenger volume of no fewer than 80,000 passengers per year.
Clearance for regional logistics operations is awarded to a supplier maintaining no fewer than 10 warehousing facilities across a regional domain.
Customs fast-track certification is awarded to an international courier demonstrating an annual customs compliance rate of at least 99 percent.
Conference delegation handling approval is given to any vendor possessing priority shuttle clearance.
Maritime cargo approval is granted to an ocean freight carrier maintaining a vessel capacity of at least 2,000 TEU.
Flight vendor preferred designation is granted to an aviation firm achieving an operational safety rating of at least 95 percent per quarter.
